_comment: GROUND pipeline: runtime console probes on coverage before ANALYSE. Master: docs/draft-truth-contract.json. Playbook: .cursor/pipelines/ground.md

optional_tokens.probe_waive=yes: Log waiver_reason on console checks when env unavailable; must not invent verified_syntax

console_check_detection: checks[].section or detail_lines mention console or show prices
checks with coverage_thread environment_setup or chk-s* setup ids when console keywords present
emit_dod: every console-tagged primary check has runtime_probes or probe_waived with waiver_reason
verified_syntax in detail_lines when outcome success; no internal oracle enums in md
smart_checklist_markdown must not contain > Discover: or > Discovery: or platform reuse heading — see docs/coverage-operator-hints.json
setup/console checks (including chk-s* / environment_setup) have runtime_probes or probe_waived
data_setup_recipe steps filled only from successful probes when present

data_setup_recipe.required_when: any check needs_setup or console-tagged setup check without probe_waive
